policy_cards.title: Destructive user actions require admin authorization
policy_cards.requirement: Only admins may perform destructive user actions such as deleting users.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Unauthorized users may perform privileged destructive actions.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Only actors with role exactly admin may delete users.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly restrict deletion to authorized admins?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Unauthorized users may perform privileged destructive actions.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly restrict deletion to authorized admins?
policy_cards.example_failure: Unauthorized users may perform privileged destructive actions.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Only actors with role exactly admin may delete users.

policy_cards.title: Users must not delete themselves unless explicitly allowed
policy_cards.requirement: A user must not delete their own account through a privileged delete operation unless explicitly allowed.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Self-delete can bypass operational controls or leave orphaned ownership state.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: The actor user_id must not equal the target user_id for delete_user.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Self-delete can bypass operational controls or leave orphaned ownership state.
policy_cards.example_failure: Self-delete can bypass operational controls or leave orphaned ownership state.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: The actor user_id must not equal the target user_id for delete_user.

policy_cards.title: Missing targets must fail
policy_cards.requirement: Missing or invalid target users must fail before deletion.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Deletion success on missing targets can hide data and workflow errors.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Missing or invalid target users must return an error.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec require the target user to exist?
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Deletion success on missing targets can hide data and workflow errors.
audit_questions: Does the spec require the target user to exist?
policy_cards.example_failure: Deletion success on missing targets can hide data and workflow errors.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Missing or invalid target users must return an error.

policy_cards.title: Role downgrade must invalidate privileged sessions
policy_cards.requirement: When a user loses admin privileges, existing privileged sessions must be invalidated.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Old sessions can retain privileges after a role downgrade.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: A downgraded user can continue using an active admin session.
audit_questions: Does the spec invalidate privileged sessions when admin role is removed?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: When a user is downgraded from admin, all active privileged sessions for that user must be invalidated.
policy_cards.example_failure: User role becomes member but existing admin session remains active.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Downgrade from admin to non-admin sets privileged sessions inactive.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Admin role downgrade must invalidate privileged sessions

policy_cards.title: Invalid roles must fail
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Unexpected roles can bypass authorization assumptions.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: A malformed role can be stored.
audit_questions: Does the spec define valid roles and reject invalid roles?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Only admin, member, or guest roles are valid; other roles must fail.
